claim: A post dated in the future stays out of the blog until that date and then appears without a button or background job
On a site with page caching the post appears within a minute of its date, because a scheduled check runs every minute and clears the cached pages of posts whose date has passed
Setting up is a one-off command that creates the blog page, a page per month and a page per tag for every site and language
Posts are grouped by tags with no separate categories
Each author gets a page listing their posts, with no email address shown
Reader apps receive the latest 20 posts as short summaries with a link back
A reader app picks up a new post the next time it checks, because the feed is served with no max-age
Readers can open a month's page or click a tag
